claims.label: Section 7.3
claims.statement: 30 μL (0.6 mmol) is listed without a chemical name.

claims.label: Materials / cited method
claims.statement: Bromine is in the materials list and reference 11 concerns molecular bromine; neither resolves the missing identity in this preparation.
claims.locator: Main PDF pp. 6 and 9, Section 7.1 and reference 11

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Retain an unknown reagent with its two reported quantities. Do not infer bromine identity or train a complete recipe from this route.

claims.label: Table 3
claims.statement: The CuFeS2 precursor entry prints Fe(stearate)2.

claims.label: Preparative identity
claims.statement: Table 2 and Section 7.9.6 describe ferric/iron(III) stearate 3f, made from ferric chloride. Section 7.8 uses iron stearate without a valence label.
claims.locator: Main PDF pp. 3, 6–7, Table 2 and Sections 7.8, 7.9.6

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Preserve both formula alternatives. Do not select a corrected oxidation state for the CuFeS2 input or create two experiments.

claims.label: Section 7.9.15
claims.statement: The product is named indium(III) laurate.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Retain the printed formula and name separately; do not repair the ligand count.

claims.label: Table 2
claims.statement: Entry 18 identifies NiCl2·6H2O and nickel stearate.

claims.label: Section 7.9.19
claims.statement: The nickel stearate paragraph names zinc chloride as its starting salt.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Do not silently correct the prose or count a second route.

claims.label: Table 2
claims.statement: MnCl2·4H2O and NiCl2·6H2O are listed; CuCl2, CoCl2, CdCl2 and SnCl2 are written without water.

claims.label: Materials list
claims.statement: MnCl2 and NiCl2 lack waters; CuCl2·2H2O, CoCl2·6H2O, CdCl2·H2O and SnCl2·2H2O are listed.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Store as-listed and table forms separately; do not calculate exact metal moles from the 0.1 g general method.

claims.label: Method A
claims.statement: Metal salt 1 equivalent, fatty acid 3 equivalents and DBU 1 equivalent are given without an explicit common basis.

claims.label: Table 1 footnote

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Retain literal equivalence values and ambiguity; do not compute an absolute DBU charge.

material_evidence_scope_notes.InP: Basel et al. separately report an InP film annealed at 270 °C for 4 h (main Figure 5f, blue trace). Its zinc-blende assignment belongs to that downstream film treatment; the as-made colloid's red trace remains without an assigned phase. This supporting film evidence is not an additional nanocrystal synthesis route or an identified physical batch.

material_asset_scope_note: The linked annealed InP film is a separate post-synthesis treatment context. Figure 5f distinguishes pristine colloid (red) from the film annealed at 270 °C for 4 h (blue); neither the film phase nor physical batch identity is transferred to the as-made route.
